result:
Hi team! 👋

Quick update on the checkout redesign: it went live Monday, and the first week of results looks great.

📈 **Conversion rate rose from 3.1% to 3.6%** in the first week. That's a meaningful lift, and it's a testament to the hard work from design, engineering, and QA to get this out the door.

⚠️ **One open issue:** the Safari payment bug is still unresolved. It's affecting a subset of Safari users at the payment step, so it's our top priority right now. Engineering is investigating, and I'll share updates as soon as we have a fix timeline.

Next steps:
• Continue monitoring conversion and error rates daily
• Prioritize the Safari fix
• Regroup later this week to review the data

Thanks again, everyone. Great work! 🙌
